lastCompletedStory.title: Re-commit implementer = codex and prove the suite green under a codex-unauthenticated environment

nextStoryContext: US-011 (CAM-420) was the final story of this PRD: it re-committed `[backend]\nimplementer = "codex"` to scripts/cam/project.toml (undoing revert ea72a1da), preserving the pre-existing `[models.codex]\nimplementer = "gpt-5.6-sol"` pin untouched. This flip is safe because US-001 through US-010 of this same PRD already retrofitted every signal-bearing implementer-side and plan-side test file with a `configPath`-fixture-isolation seam (RunSupervisorOptions.configPath / RunPlanPhaseOptions.configPath), so the live project.toml's implementer backend no longer perturbs any test that shouldn't care about it. AC9 dual-run acceptance evidence, measured on this machine (2026-07-26): (a) plain `bun test` (codex-authenticated) -> 5634 pass / 0 fail; (b) `HOME=$(mktemp -d) bun test` (codex-unauthenticated, simulating CI's runners per .github/workflows/ci.yml:26, since an emptied HOME makes ~/.codex/auth.json unreadable to codexAuthCheck's point-read at src/supervisor/codex-auth.ts:63) -> IDENTICAL 5634 pass / 0 fail. Both runs recorded here per issue AC9 (this file is per-story-rotating per patterns.md:909, so the durable record of this evidence also lives in a new patterns.md bullet appended by this story, at the end of the file, right after the US-007 CAM-420 bullet). AC11 repo-wide comment sweep confirmed clean before this story even started: `grep -rq 'injectable through RunSupervisorOptions' test/` already returned no matches (US-009 had already fixed the one stale plan-runner-codex-auth.test.ts occurrence; the other two named-in-audit occurrences, loop-model-resolution.test.ts:132-133 and loop.test.ts:4285ish, were already the wrap-safe LONGER phrase, not the banned short one). The patterns.md CAM-350 US-003 bullet (originally at line 877, 'readPhaseBackend is called directly ... no configPath override wired') was annotated inline as '[superseded by CAM-420, 2026-07-26]' rather than deleted, preserving the historical record while pointing to the new fixture-injectable-contract bullet at file end. Zero src/ changes: implementer edits were confined to project.toml (1 line) and patterns.md (annotation + new bullet). This closes CAM-420 entirely (US-001 through US-011, all 11 stories) -- there is no next story in this PRD; the supervisor's review cycle is next.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Config-flip + patterns.md documentation story: no new external library surface touched. The [backend].implementer = "codex" TOML key and the RunSupervisorOptions/RunPlanPhaseOptions.configPath DI seam were both already implemented and validated by prior stories in this same PRD (US-001 through US-010).
